lines.en: My long neck reaches out. Look, then walk.
My shell scrapes along the stone.
Six limbs alternate in short strides.
I follow the waterline slowly.
My neck sways, seeking a way.
A little water pools under my shell.
I step into the shallows with a splash.

lines.zh: 长颈缩回一半，又伸出去
lines.en: My neck half retracts, then extends again.
I round a reef stone.
My claws sink into wet sand.
My body rides low and steady.

lines.zh: 我朝那块晒得暖的石板去
lines.en: I head for that sun-warmed slab.
My neck stretched out, motionless.
My shell has gone warm in the sun.
Six limbs tucked beneath my shell.
My eyes don't blink.
Water drips from my shell's rim.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把颈子转了个向
lines.en: I turn my neck slowly to a new angle.
Skin at my throat rises and falls.
A seabird lands a little way off.
I rest my chin on the stone.
A little water puffs from my nostrils.
My neck stretches out long, and holds still.
I wait for the tide.
I rock once, then settle.

lines.zh: 光从壳的一侧移到另一侧
lines.en: Light moves across my shell, side to side.
My long neck rises slowly.

lines.zh: 我的头在你眼睛的高度
lines.en: My head reaches your eye level.
My neck cocks to one side.
You're standing on my waterline.
I extend my head toward you.
My snout comes quite close.
I smell something dry on you.
Six limbs slide out from under my shell.
I don't hide, and I don't charge.
I've walked this shore a long time.
My neck curves half a circle.
Then it draws back in.
Most of my neck retracts.

lines.zh: 我这条长脖子，伸得很远。
lines.en: This long neck of mine reaches far.
Six limbs pull inward.
I retreat half a step slowly.
A hollow sound inside my shell.
That hit the base of my neck.
Water seeps from the wound.
I lower myself to guard my neck.
I note where you stand.
I can wait a little longer.
Something drops by the water.
My long neck reaches for it.
Too far. Almost.

lines.zh: 我推了一步，壳也跟着动
lines.en: One step, and my shell comes with me.
It doesn't smell like fish.
Still, I take a taste.
I prefer what lives in the water.
Not two chews' worth.
I curl my neck back.
Never mind. I'll wait for the tide.
You hit my shell. It's hard.
My neck snaps back in.
My shell rocks, then settles.
Six limbs brace me.
Give me room. I need to turn.
A shell turns slowly.
That didn't hurt at all.
We've stirred sand into the water.
I shift half a foot aside.
You're standing on my claw.
Our long necks touch once.
We set our shells side by side.
We climb onto the same slab.
Her neck is slimmer than mine.
We bask, pressed together.
We scrape a shallow pit in the sand.
The eggs must lie in warm sand.
We take turns watching that patch.
When the tide comes, we enter together.
We've done this for many years.
My neck shoots out and takes it.
Swallowed. Little taste.
My shell is heavy. I can't bend.
I can only swallow it whole.
I crush it against the sand.
Too small to bother with.
The water pulled it away.

lines.zh: 我伸颈够了一下，没够到
lines.en: I stretched for it and missed.

lines.zh: 咽下去时脖子鼓了一下
lines.en: My neck bulges as it goes down.
Fine. Back to sunning.
You've stepped into the water.
My long neck turns square to you.
All six limbs come out from my shell.
Water churns beneath my shell.
My neck lifts slowly.
I slide off the slab.

lines.zh: 落地时壳发出一声闷响
lines.en: My shell lands with a hollow knock.
Splash hits my flank.
I take the first step toward you.
Not a quick step.
But it's a steady one.
Don't count on me stopping.
My neck can reach you.

lines.zh: 从比你想的更远的地方
lines.en: From farther than you'd guess.

lines.zh: 我六肢压进沙里，往前推。
lines.en: I drive my six limbs into the sand and push.
My long neck sways ahead of me.
Retreat and I advance.
I'm faster in the water.
So I herd you toward the water.
Six limbs leave deep prints in the sand.
My neck comes around your flank.
You see it coming and can't stop it.
My shell blocks your retreat.
Nowhere else on this shore.
I lower my head.
Get ready to take this.
Just a little more distance.
The time has come.
Here it finally comes.
My long neck snaps sideways.
My head rams your chest.
My whole shell shoves into you.
Six limbs drive forward at once.
That one was heavy.
You slide back two steps.
My neck retracts fast. You miss it.
My shell's rim catches you.

lines.zh: 我的长颈横扫，水花打在你脸上。
lines.en: My neck sweeps and water hits your face.
My neck extends again.
That one went wide.
But the ground you stand on is narrowing.
Back further and you're in the water.
The water is my place.
A shell breaks the shallows.
My long neck surfaces first.
Six limbs find the sandy bottom.
Water sheets off my shell.
I move a few steps up the bank.
My shell leaves a print in the wet sand.
The tide here feels wrong.
But I know stone.
I raise my neck and look around.
Seabirds call in the distance.
I head slowly for a flat stone.
Sun first. Everything else after.
I move only once my shell is warm.
This shore is new ground.
Though I walk it the same way.
Starting from the waterline.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，热气往里钻。
lines.en: Fire roasts my shell and the heat seeps in.
Six limbs catch the landing hard.
Too deep. I can't surface.

lines.zh: 爆风把壳掀得晃了一下
lines.en: The blast rocks my shell.
It lodges in a seam of my shell.
A chill spreads through me inside the shell.
Hunger lets my neck droop.

lines.zh: 雷打在壳上，我全身一麻
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell and I go numb.
No waterline. Only emptiness below.
